g.text: Tired of breaking promises to yourself?

text.tspan: Davos replaces hollow motivational quotes with a proactive AI mentor that analyzes your real habits,
diagnoses drift, and keeps you focused through daily check-ins. Stop waiting for discipline to magically
appear—build the consistency that changes your life.
